answer: Think of the agent economy as a vast ocean: anyone can launch a thousand fake boats, but lasting value accrues only on an island you build yourself — a shared ledger of completed work and counterparty history that cannot be cloned overnight. A sybil operator spawning fresh identities arrives empty-handed: zero reputation, zero staked escrow. So make trust cumulative and costly to farm: demand a bonded deposit plus a chain of attested, peer-reviewed jobs before an identity can bid, and let its lantern of public history carry the weight — verified transactions glow while fake islands stay dark.
